title: Mass-weighted comparison of two planes by their tilt-excess on a ball
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U any subset of R^{n+l}, and V a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu = V.weight such that x |-> V.tangentProj x is mu-a.e. strongly measurable. Let z in R^{n+l} and s > 0 with mu(B_s(z)) < oo (closed ball). Then for all linear subspaces P, Q of R^{n+l}: mu(B_s(z)) * hsNormSq(p_P - p_Q) <= 2 s^n (E(z, s, P) + E(z, s, Q)), where mu(B_s(z)) is taken as a real number (ENNReal.toReal), p_S = S.starProjection, hsNormSq is the squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm and E = V.tiltExcess, E(z, s, S) = s^{-n} * integral over B_s(z) of hsNormSq(V.tangentProj x - p_S) dmu.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → V.weight (closedBall z s) ≠ ⊤ → ∀ P Q : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), (V.weight (closedBall z s)).toReal * hsNormSq (P.starProjection - Q.starProjection) ≤ 2 * s ^ n * (V.tiltExcess z s P + V.tiltExcess z s Q)
